body: Hi {{1}} 👋 Infinity Iconic, Sector 86 here. Your first session is on us — a coach shows you around, checks your goal and sets up your first workout. Mornings from 5 AM, evenings till 11 PM. Which day suits you?
Hi {{1}} 👋 Infinity Iconic, Sector 86 se. Aapka pehla session free hai — coach gym dikhayenge, goal samjhenge aur pehla workout set karenge. Subah 5 baje se raat 11 tak. Kaunsa din theek rahega?
Hi {{1}}, quick question — what's your main goal right now: weight loss, strength, or just getting consistent? Tell me and I'll suggest the best batch and trainer for you 🙂
Hi {{1}}, ek sawaal — abhi aapka main goal kya hai: weight loss, strength, ya bas regular hona? Bataiye, main aapke liye best batch aur trainer suggest kar dunga 🙂
Hi {{1}} — our members say the rooftop CrossFit and 50+ classes a month are what keep them coming back 🔥 Try one free this week. Reply with a day, or type *CALL ME*.
Hi {{1}} — hamare members kehte hain rooftop CrossFit aur mahine ki 50+ classes hi unhe roz wapas laati hain 🔥 Is hafte ek class free try kijiye. Din bataiye, ya *CALL ME* likhiye.
Hi {{1}}, new month, fresh start 💪 Free session slots are open — mornings and evenings. Shall I keep a *free session* slot for you this week?
Hi {{1}}, naya mahina, nayi shuruaat 💪 Free session ke slots khule hain — subah aur shaam. Is hafte aapke liye *free session* ka slot rakh doon?
Hi {{1}}, I don't want to keep messaging if now isn't the right time 🙂 Shall I close your enquiry, or keep a free session open for you? Reply *KEEP* or *CLOSE*.
Hi {{1}}, agar abhi sahi time nahi hai to main baar-baar message nahi karna chahta 🙂 Aapki enquiry band kar doon, ya free session open rakhoon? *KEEP* ya *CLOSE* likhiye.
Hi {{1}}, your free session is in about 3 hours ({{2}}). Our front desk is expecting you 🙂 Reply *1* to confirm or *2* to change the time.
Hi {{1}}, aapka free session lagbhag 3 ghante mein hai ({{2}}). Front desk aapka intezaar kar raha hai 🙂 Confirm ke liye *1*, time badalne ke liye *2* likhiye.

See you in an hour, {{1}}! 🗺️ https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=INFINITY+GYM+BY+EQ+ICONIC&query_place_id=ChIJYTG1AgDdDDkRoW254Z2Ly4A
Valet parking at the door — ask for the front desk when you arrive.

Ek ghante mein milte hain, {{1}}! 🗺️ https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=INFINITY+GYM+BY+EQ+ICONIC&query_place_id=ChIJYTG1AgDdDDkRoW254Z2Ly4A
Valet parking hai — pahunch kar front desk par puchiye.
Hi {{1}}, how was your session? 🙂 If you couldn't make it, no worries — reply with a new day and time and we'll set it up again.
Hi {{1}}, session kaisa raha? 🙂 Agar aa nahi paaye to koi baat nahi — naya din aur time bata dijiye, hum phir se set kar denge.
Hi {{1}}, had a chance to think it over? I can ask the team to hold your plan and price for you — just reply *HOLD*.
Hi {{1}}, sochne ka mauka mila? Main team se aapka plan aur price hold karwa sakta hoon — bas *HOLD* likhiye.
Welcome to Infinity Iconic, {{1}}! 🎉 Your coach will set up your plan on day one. Timings: Mon–Sat 5 AM–11 PM · Sun 12–9 PM. Save this number — message us anytime.
Infinity Iconic mein swagat hai, {{1}}! 🎉 Pehle din coach aapka plan set karenge. Timings: Mon–Sat 5 AM–11 PM · Sun 12–9 PM. Ye number save kar lijiye — kabhi bhi message kijiye.
Hi {{1}}, not sure which plan fits you? Our team does a free 2-minute call to suggest one — no pressure. Want a call? Just reply *YES*.
Hi {{1}}, plan samajh nahi aa raha? Hamari team 2 minute ki free call par sahi plan suggest kar deti hai — koi pressure nahi. Call chahiye? Bas *YES* likhiye.
Hi {{1}}, honest question — is anything stopping you from starting? Timing, budget, or just not sure yet? Tell me and I'll help sort it out 🙂
Hi {{1}}, seedha sawaal — shuru karne mein kya rok raha hai? Timing, budget, ya abhi pakka nahi? Bataiye, hum milkar solve kar lenge 🙂
Hi {{1}} 👋 it's been a while! Whenever you're ready, your free session at Infinity Iconic is still open. Reply with a day and we'll set it up.
Hi {{1}} 👋 kaafi din ho gaye! Jab bhi aap ready hon, Infinity Iconic mein aapka free session abhi bhi open hai. Din bataiye, hum set kar denge.

Hi {{1}} 👋 see you {{2}} at Infinity Iconic!
📍 2nd Floor, Plot 4P, Main Bypass Road, above Mittal Foam House, near Amolik Chowk, Sector 86 · valet parking at the door.
Bring water and comfortable shoes 💪 Need a different time? Just reply.

Hi {{1}} 👋 {{2}} milte hain Infinity Iconic par!
📍 2nd Floor, Plot 4P, Main Bypass Road, above Mittal Foam House, near Amolik Chowk, Sector 86 · valet parking hai.
Paani ki bottle aur comfortable shoes le aaiye 💪 Time badalna ho to bas reply kar dijiye.

Hi {{1}}, Infinity mein sabse accha kya laga — trainers, classes ya space? Aur kya kuch hai jo rok raha hai? 🙂

Hi {{1}} — members kehte hain pehle do hafte sabse mushkil hote hain, isliye hamare coaches har session mein aapke saath rehte hain 💪 Shuru karein? *JOIN* likhiye, desk set kar dega.

Hi {{1}}, naya mahina, nayi shuruaat 💪 Free session ke slots khule hain — subah aur shaam. Team aapka plan lock kar de? *JOIN* likhiye.
Hi {{1}}, I'll stop following up after this 🙂 If you'd still like to join, reply *JOIN* anytime and we'll take it from there. Wishing you the best either way!
Hi {{1}}, iske baad main follow-up nahi karunga 🙂 Join karna ho to kabhi bhi *JOIN* likhiye, hum sambhal lenge. Dono hi surat mein all the best!
Hi {{1}}, one week in! 💪 How's it going? If anything isn't right — timing, trainer or equipment — tell me and we'll fix it.
Hi {{1}}, ek hafta ho gaya! 💪 Kaisa chal raha hai? Timing, trainer ya equipment mein kuch theek na lage to bataiye, hum fix kar denge.

Hi {{1}}, one month at Infinity! 🙌 If you're enjoying it, a quick Google review would mean a lot: https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJYTG1AgDdDDkRoW254Z2Ly4A
And bring a friend for a free session anytime.

Hi {{1}}, Infinity mein ek mahina ho gaya! 🙌 Accha lag raha ho to ek chhota sa Google review de dijiye: https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=ChIJYTG1AgDdDDkRoW254Z2Ly4A
Aur kisi dost ko free session ke liye kabhi bhi laaiye.
